description: Inspect a remote MCP server. Use when an agent needs to know what a remote MCP server offers before connecting it: transport, protocol version, whether it needs auth, and the tools it lists. A GET checks the URL first; initialize and tools/list are POSTed only if that GET identifies an MCP server, and no tool is ever called. Remote text comes back labelled as untrusted third-party data. Cost: 2 credits per call.

url.description: The public http(s) URL of the MCP endpoint, such as https://example.com/mcp.

name: mcp_inspect
